The republic of Lee
the republic of Lee or just simply Lee (Leeian: Lē/Lēēan) is a fictional country in North Europe. Lee has a population around 54 400 214(2025) and is the highest populated country in Northern Europe. Lee is known for Its beautiful nature in the Northern and western regions, and Lee is also known for their food specially the meats and the most popular food from Lee is a Sausage called Kïelsa which is Smoked, which is  typically seasoned with Pepper,Grill seasonings(Traditionally a mix of Paprika, Crushed red pepper and garlic powder). And the current Prime minister of Lee is Ändre Broholm(2022-present).
